snippet.title: Purrfect Ascent - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist --  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4370840/Purrfect_Ascent/

Take up the challenge and face true high-stakes platforming as you struggle upwards in search of your lost kitten. Be warned: one misstep and you might tumble all the way back down.

Inspired by classic games of the 8/16-bit era in gaming. Simple controls to learn, but difficult to master as you reach greater heights with each jump. If you love games that don't hold your hand and who challenge you to overcome through trial and error, then go ahead, attempt to climb the tower. After all, your kitten is counting on you.
